_what: protect and defer (spec v6 section 7, D165 (D)): the REQUEST and STATE counterfactual decisions and the compound, behind live2_cf_protect_defer, arm-scoped instance attribute, default off
_protocol: one dry cell per process; planner wall-clock cutoff patched off so a digest is a property of the arm and not of the machine's load; POSTED workload knobs (40:40:20, lh_req, ss2, epg, per-frame upload, re-ask mean 30 s, 16 devices, 1200 s); seed 4
_digest_recipe: sha256(json.dumps(rows without arm_version, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), default=float))[:16] - the committed recipe; a digest is comparable ONLY within one recipe
_register: DRY. A dry cell does not exercise price (covex-v6-rules and covex-v6-rules-wo are byte-identical dry; D174 part B3 found the same), so nothing here is evidence about the MAGNITUDE of harm against a real engine, only about the logic, the determinism, the port rule and the sign

mechanism.compound: protect and defer (spec v6 section 7, D165 (D))

margin.source: cf_objective.attainment_margin(cf_margin.MARGIN_CF) = 0.16456 / 0.250 = 0.65824000000000005; D177 (3) states it as 0.6582 in on-time units

weight.default: constant 1.0 (covex-v6-fair's deficit weight is NOT wired here; w = 1 + 2.0 x shortfall floored at 1 is another session's component)
weight.adapter: D178 (2)'s weight is per query TYPE; this injection point is per DEVICE, so the adapter maps a device to its type's weight. One device has one type (spec v6 section 2, D148), so the map is total and unambiguous.
weight.note: 'decider' is the ruled reading (D171 (1), D178 (5), spec v6 section 7): the bar is MARGIN_CF scaled by the deficit weight of the device the DECISION IS ABOUT. 'max_harmed' is the WRONG reading, kept reachable only so what it does can be measured: under it the harmed type's weight scales harm and bar together, so the ratio that decides is unchanged and the deficit weight is INERT (cancelled by geometry), while the DECIDING device's own deficit is ignored entirely. Measured in cf_pd_tests.py::t_sign.

harm.note: 'on-time-cloud' is D177's currency and the unit MARGIN_CF_ON_TIME is expressed in: a displaced request's loss is w_j x (p_before - p_after) on-time CLOUD answers, and a refused request contributes nothing because p = 0 on both sides (D175 (1): only a DELIVERED cloud answer replaces the device's). 'device-discounted' multiplies each row by (1 - p_device_on_time_j), which is the literal reading of D165 (B)'s sentence 'a question whose device answer was already on time loses nothing when the cloud answer is late'. THE TWO ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT COSMETIC: the measured Orin tables give p_device_on_time = 1.0 for EVERY robot question and for dashcam at EVERY episode position (v5/cf_objective.py, the DeviceLatency note), so under 'device-discounted' the harm of displacing an alert or a recall request is EXACTLY ZERO and this compound could only ever fire on assistance. Both are computed and reported; the default is the one whose units match the bar, and the choice is a user ruling, not this module's.

kappa.source: v5/cf_margin.safety_factor(cf_cost.load_residuals()); residuals results/orchestration/live2/frozen_test/runs (committed request logs), split 'fit on the non-hybrid arms, test on the hybrids'
kappa.register: FITTED and committed: q90 of actual over predicted service, the same factor v5/cf_planner.py:357 uses. TWO CAVEATS: its split is held-out-BY-ARM ('fit on the non-hybrid arms, test on the hybrids'), not D125's words 'FIT/DEV'; and the residual summary itself carries gate_status 'FAILS: decode over-predicts by 25 to 32 percent in every held-out class and warm is confounded with arm (spec v5 section 12)'. A latest-start time quoted from it must carry both.

alert_uncached_tokens.what_it_actually_measures: the median uncached tokens of an EP-G dashcam request over 39,949 sent requests in the four committed covex-v6-base cells; it is 374 in each cell separately
alert_uncached_tokens.valid_for: sizing the SERVICE TIME of a pending alert instant, which is what the on-time curve needs. It is a population median, so a single instant's own episode length is not represented and a long episode's harm is understated
alert_uncached_tokens.not_valid_for: any claim about one named instant's tokens

mechanism.what_a_dry_cell_cannot_establish: the MAGNITUDE of harm against a real engine, and therefore whether the bar is ever crossed in a live regime. A dry cell does not exercise price: covex-v6-rules and covex-v6-rules-wo are byte-identical dry, so the charge mode is unexercised dry, and D174 part B3 found the same.

static_isolation._claim: the stronger half: no file outside this component imports it, so no committed arm can reach this code at all
static_isolation.consequence: arms.py must gain two lines for a LIVE cell to resolve these names, and this session does not edit arms.py because another session has uncommitted work in it; the lines are in the report

CONTROL_VALIDATION_SWITCH_OFF_AGAINST_IT._claim: CLAUDE.md's rule 7: the CONTROL's own numbers are checked before the comparison is read. This is the switch-OFF arm against the rung-2 base it must reproduce, at the full 1,200 s, row by row
CONTROL_VALIDATION_SWITCH_OFF_AGAINST_IT.identical_at_300s: YES, measured separately: 2,968 rows each, no positional difference, so the two are the same arm and the divergence is late in the cell
CONTROL_VALIDATION_SWITCH_OFF_AGAINST_IT.reading: a difference here is NOT attributable to this component, whose code does not run with the switch off; it is the documented OPEN DEFECT 'dry decisions do not reproduce across runs' (spec v6 section 12), which the fidelity table records for planner-carrying arms IN ONE PROCESS and which these runs show ACROSS processes as well, on the share-admission base only

how_to_read_the_stopping_conditions.AT_1x_MEMORY P1: EXPLAINED AND SUPERSEDED by AT_1x_MEMORY_WITH_THE_CACHE_KEY_INSTRUMENT, where the same comparison is EXACT. The cause is rung 2's `id(obs)` cache key, not this component: see CONTROL_VALIDATION and the --diag-epoch-cache-key help text. It is left in the list because the committed configuration still carries the defect
how_to_read_the_stopping_conditions.AT_1x_MEMORY P2 ABSENT LINK: A REAL ABSENT LINK AND DECLARED AS ONE, never as a negative: at 1x the GPU KV pool has room, the eviction gate is reached and crossed twice on the c5attr base and not at all on the shares base, and no deviation is expressible. CLAUDE.md Rule 2: UNEXERCISED at 1x. The 0.25x cell is the registered sweep that reaches it
how_to_read_the_stopping_conditions.AT_1x P6 c5attr always_over_bar: the flag fires on n = 2, where 'always' carries no information; the 0.25x distribution with n = 119 is the one to read
